website privacy.

Information about browsing this website and contacting us.

Website features

This website’s application code does not use analytics, advertising scripts, tracking pixels, cookies, or browser storage. Fonts and artwork are served locally. There are no accounts or newsletter forms.

Hosting

The fundelits.com website is hosted by Vercel. The domain is registered through Namecheap.

Hosting details pending. Request logs, recipients, and retention practices must be confirmed before this policy is finalized for App Store submission.

External links

App Store links, when available, open Apple’s website. Email links open your email application. These services process information under their own policies.

Contacting support

When you email support, we receive the information you send to us and use it to respond to your request.

The retention period for support correspondence is awaiting publisher confirmation.

Contact

Contact Publisher identity pending confirmation at support@fundelits.com.
